title: Add playable choice modeling for creation/level-up choices
description: Deficiency #8. Choice-bearing features are often prose. Add typed choice prompts for: class skills/tools, subclass, spells/cantrips, equipment options, languages, ASI-vs-feat, Fighting Style, Metamagic, Eldritch Invocations, terrain/enemy options, and subclass feature options (e.g. Channel Divinity) where present. Schema already permits skillChoices, toolProficiencyChoices, startingEquipment, progression — promote these from optional enrichment into the hard re-freeze bar. Re-freeze gate: FAIL if any level-1 or level-up-required player choice is only prose; out-of-scope choices must carry a named unsupported marker.
design: LIKELY EPIC-SCALE — split into child beads once scoped against the code. Expected slices: (a) class skill/tool choices; (b) subclass selection; (c) spell/cantrip choices; (d) equipment-option choices; (e) language choices; (f) ASI-vs-feat; (g) Fighting Style / Metamagic / Eldritch Invocations / terrain-enemy options; (h) subclass feature options (e.g. Channel Divinity). Each slice should have its own choice-coverage gate contribution (.11) and smoke case (.12). Promote .9 to a sub-epic if scoping confirms breadth.
